raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "12.0"

package:
  name: pyslang
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/MikePopoloski/slang/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 64b3eb9d38ee126e009cbb8da0cfa6f68d970334e52ba084ad7c68e4b5fa804c
  patches:
    # Build for each Python ABI without the separately packaged nanobind backend.
    - per-python-nanobind.patch
    # Use the conda fmt library without compiling another copy into slang.
    - system-fmt.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - python -c "from importlib.metadata import distribution; import shutil; d = distribution('nanobind'); shutil.copyfile(d.locate_file(next(p for p in d.files if str(p).endswith('licenses/LICENSE'))), 'nanobind-LICENSE')"
    - python -c "import nanobind; from pathlib import Path; p = Path(nanobind.__file__).parent / 'ext/robin_map/include/tsl/robin_hash.h'; Path('robin-map-LICENSE').write_text(p.read_text().split('*/', 1)[0] + '*/')"
    - if: unix and build_platform != target_platform and "cp314t" in python
      then: CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS} -DPython_FIND_ABI=OFF;OFF;OFF;ON -DPython_INCLUDE_DIR=${PREFIX}/include/python3.14t"
    - if: unix
      then: CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS} -GNinja -DCMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES=OFF -DSLANG_USE_SYSTEM_FMT=ON -DSLANG_USE_SYSTEM_BOOST=ON -DSLANG_USE_SYSTEM_TOMLPLUSPLUS=ON -DFETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED=ON" python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - if: win
      then: set "CMAKE_ARGS=%CMAKE_ARGS% -GNinja -DCMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES=OFF -DSLANG_USE_MIMALLOC=OFF -DSLANG_USE_SYSTEM_FMT=ON -DSLANG_USE_SYSTEM_BOOST=ON -DSLANG_USE_SYSTEM_TOMLPLUSPLUS=ON -DFETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED=ON" && python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake >=3.28
    - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core
    - nanobind >=3.0.1,<4
    - nanobind-abi
    - fmt >=12.1
    - libboost-devel
    - tomlplusplus >=3.4
    - if: not win
      then:
        - mimalloc >=3.5
  run:
    - python
    - slang-verilog ==${{ version }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyslang
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - pyslang/tests
        - pyslang/examples/extract_logic_names.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script: pytest -q pyslang/tests

about:
  homepage: https://sv-lang.com/
  summary: Python bindings for slang, a library for compiling SystemVerilog
  description: |
    pyslang provides Python bindings for slang, a software library that
    provides various components needed to lexically analyze, parse, type
    check, and elaborate SystemVerilog code.
  license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - nanobind-LICENSE
    - robin-map-LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/MikePopoloski/slang
  documentation: https://sv-lang.com/pyslang/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - timkpaine
